summary.text: Carol Hubbard is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 122 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Spencer Frye.
An educator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she would be visible and available to voters in Athens-Clarke County.

paragraphs.text: Carol Hubbard earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Georgia, a graduate degree from Georgia State University, a degree from the University of West Georgia and a Ph.D. from Liberty University.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.
Hubbard advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her goals include partnering with local leaders to bring state resources to local projects and reviewing state transportation project timelines, including work on the Loop.
She also said Athens-Clarke County needs more police officers and better jail facilities and remediation programs.
